answer: A sponsor may vouch for three identities per epoch, locking a 90-credit bond in three 30-credit shares. Each vouch plants a ticket in the garden registry. The karst ledger matches tickets to shares for audit. A fake burns its 30-credit share and costs one next slot at the epoch zenith. Rented tickets are keyed to the job and burn on audit. Faking 1,000 identities needs 334 sponsors and 30,000 credits. An honest sponsor pays once.
